Explorer.role: Finds where the bug is, with evidence. Does not change code.

Planner.role: Turns findings into the smallest fix plan, split by behavior.

Implementer.role: Applies the plan, only in the files it may change.

TestWriter.role: Writes the regression test that catches the bug.

Reviewer.role: Looks for counterexamples to the diff: concurrency, repeated messages, partial failure, unauthorized users.
